pages.text: Next, you'll want to know where you are. An old sailor named &6Dorrin Saltmarsh&r keeps &6Saltmarsh Provisions&r, on the east side of the square. Torches, rods, rope and maps, and a better teacher of the compass than I am.
He'll show you your &6minimap&r, your &6world map&r and how waypoints work. You'll want all of that before you leave town. Go and say I sent you. Mention the stew; he behaves when I do.
